relations.subject: ui:couchbase-web-console
relations.evidence: If the user has been assigned the _Full Administrator_ role, they have complete access to all features; and can therefore read, write, execute, and manage without constraint.

relations.subject: ui:couchbase-web-console
relations.evidence: Couchbase Web Console is typically accessible at port _8091_, of the host system, although the port number may be different if _secure_ console-access has been established: see [Manage Console Access](../manage-security/manage-console-access.md), for information.

notable_absence.finding: 'The only service not to have a tab is the Data Service; which is managed by means of the Buckets, Documents, and Views tabs.' - every other of the six installed services (analytics, eventing, index, query, search, plus the not-installed Backup Service) gets its own identically-named left-nav tab, but the Data Service is deliberately spread across three differently-named tabs with no single 'Data Service' surface in the UI at all.

cross_component_finding: This page is the navigational hub for the whole manage/ module: nearly every other page in this batch (manage-statistics, manage-logging, manage-indexes, manage-documents, import-documents, manage-backup-and-restore, monitoring-indexes) is reached from a tab or sub-tab this page names first (Dashboard, Logs, Indexes, Documents/Import, Backup). The page also links to the Search screen's create-mapping content via an unresolved fragment reference: '[Searching from the UI](#fts:fts-searching-from-the-ui.adoc)' - a raw Antora xref fragment left in the rendered Markdown rather than a working link, unlike every other cross-reference on the page.
